query: 上海 "The Riverside" 咖啡 门面 地址
content: 我来查一下上海 “The Riverside” 咖啡店的门面地址。

sources.title: Restaurant Riverside Cafe @ Four Points Shanghai, Pudong in ...
sources.description: Restaurant Riverside Cafe @ Four Points Shanghai, Pudong in Shanghai, 东方 29 号. DiningCity, the world's leading restaurant guide and online reservation website.

sources.title: Ten riverside cafés in Shanghai
sources.description:
Address: Sky Lobby L, Baiyulan Business Building, No 501 East Daming Road.

Open: Tuesday-Sunday 9 am-6:30 pm, 7 pm-11 pm; Monday 9 am-7 pm

2. J'S Link (North Bund Branch)

Situated near Suzhou Creek by the Zhapulu Bridge, J'S Link offers outdoor seating surrounded by historic buildings and a view of the Oriental Pearl Tower. Enjoy a cup of coffee while soaking in the picturesque riverside scenery.

Address: No 224 North Suzhou Road

Open: Monday-Sunday 11 am-11 pm

3. REi·Flower Coffee Bar

Adjacent to J'S Link, REi·Flower Coffee Bar provides a prime spot to gaze at the Lujiazui skyline. Operating until 1 am, this establishment transitions from a coffee shop to a cozy bar in the evenings, offering a seamless afternoon-to-night experience. [...] Their signature Osmanthus Rice Wine Latte blends the richness of coffee with a unique flavor of rice wine, making it a must-try for enthusiasts.

Address: No 4598 Binjiang Avenue

Open: Monday to Sunday 9 am-9 pm

Source: Official WeChat account of POP SHANGHAI via "xiaozimeishi"

Photos by Sanjin, Yuan

#### FAQs [...] Address: No 234 North Suzhou Road (380 meters from Tiantong Road Metro Station Exit 3)

Open: Monday-Sunday 10:30 am-1 am

4. LINs Cafe

Located in the M50 Creative Park, LINs Cafe is adorned with antique furniture. With three floors to explore and exquisite riverside terraces overlooking Suzhou Creek, this cafe promises a cinematic experience.

Address: 3F, Building 22, M50 Creative Park, No 50 Moganshan Road

Open: Monday-Sunday 9 am-10 pm

5. Good Vibe Station

Nestled along the Yangpu riverside, Good Vibe Station is not just a coffee shop, but also a hub for music lovers. With live performances on Fridays and Saturdays, this cafe offers a unique riverside experience for music enthusiasts and coffee aficionados alike.

Address: No 640 Yangshupu Road

Open: Monday-Sunday 11 am-10 pm
